title: 沃兹尼亚奇：温布尔登网球锦标赛首秀中央公园草地赛
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's incredible. It's, of course, trying to expand and grow into a different market as well and bringing it to America, which is a very important market for Wimbledon and get the American fans involved.
segments.zh: 太棒了。温网正努力拓展新市场，尤其是美国市场，让美国球迷参与进来。

segments.en: And also for people who've never had a chance to be at Wimbledon to actually bring it here, bring it to Central Park.
segments.zh: 也让从未去过温网的人有机会体验，把它带到中央公园。

segments.en: I mean, it looks beautiful. Everything is set up by the same way as it is in London.
segments.zh: 这里布置得很美，一切都和伦敦一样。

segments.en: So you have the groundskeepers from London have come here to set up the court and make it proper and make it perfect and just the way it looks. It's beautiful and we're so excited to be here.
segments.zh: 伦敦的场地维护人员过来搭建球场，确保一切完美。太美了，我们很兴奋。

segments.en: This is the first time we get to play on grass in Central Park and I think it's going to be a really fun event.
segments.zh: 这是我们第一次在中央公园的草地上打球，一定会很有趣。

segments.en: What exactly is the aim here? I mean, are they just trying to attract a broader audience, a broader international audience?
segments.zh: 目标是什么？是为了吸引更广泛的国际观众吗？

segments.en: I mean, we do actually have a big tournament that goes on here in the US every year, the US open.
segments.zh: 美国每年都有美网这样的大型赛事。

segments.en: I think it's trying to just get Wimbledon outside of the UK and expand and look into
segments.zh: 我认为这是为了让温网走出英国，扩大影响力。

segments.en: getting more people involved, get the kids involved and also just kind of Wimbledon is obviously such an iconic event.
segments.zh: 让更多人参与，包括孩子。温网本身就是一个标志性赛事。

segments.en: A little bit like the Masters, but at the same time you want to make people feel a part of the event and just get a little taste of what it's like being there
segments.zh: 有点像大师赛，但同时也想让人们感受到参与感，体验一下现场氛围。

segments.en: and maybe hopefully it will attract people to make the trip over there as well and go see it and go be part of it.
segments.zh: 希望这能吸引人们也去那里看看，参与其中。

segments.en: Well, there's plenty of interest in the court that we've set up here and you can see people milling around and taking photos.
segments.zh: 我们搭建的球场吸引了很多兴趣，可以看到人们四处走动拍照。
